adjudication.rationale: In both payment-success handlers the CalendarEvent is constructed with only a single destination calendar: `const selectedDestinationCalendar = booking.destinationCalendar || user.destinationCalendar;` and then `destinationCalendar: selectedDestinationCalendar ? [selectedDestinationCalendar] : []` (Stripe webhook.ts) and similarly in paypal-webhook.ts. Meanwhile, this diff refactors `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to be an array and updates event creation (`EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`) to iterate over `event.destinationCalendar` and create events per destination calendar. For collective/team events, handleNewBooking now collects other hosts’ destination calendars (`teamDestinationCalendars`) and pushes them into `evt.destinationCalendar`, implying multiple calendars should be supported. The payment-success path does not include those additional host calendars, so any calendar writes triggered from payment success will only target the single selected calendar rather than all hosts’ calendars.
